text: dsh-session-doctor 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的会话管理插件，向 DSH 注册五个工具，帮助用户查看和处理同一宿主中的会话。它可以列出会话及标题、工作目录和在线状态，读取用户与助手的对话文本，检查 agent 状态、排队消息数和最近事件；对于正在运行且疑似卡住的 agent，可发送取消信号并保留 inbox 排队消息。用户也可以向其他会话发送消息，在线会话直接接收，持久化会话会先恢复再投递。适合需要检查多个 DSH 会话状态、恢复卡住工作或查看进度的场景。

dsh-session-doctor is a DeepSeek Harness plugin with five tools to list sessions, read conversations, inspect agent status, recover stalled work while keeping queued messages, and message live or resumed sessions.
想查看当前 DSH 进程里有哪些会话和它们的运行状态
怎么确认另一个 agent 是在线、空闲还是卡住了？
帮我读一下指定会话最近的用户和助手对话
让卡住的会话停止当前任务，同时保留排队中的消息
我想从这个会话给另一个会话发一条指令
离线保存的会话能不能恢复后再接收消息？
How can I inspect the status and queued messages of another DSH session?
I need to read the recent conversation from a different session.
Can I cancel a stalled agent while keeping its queued messages?
Send a message to a persisted session after bringing it back online.
列出会话：调用 list_sessions 获取会话标题、id、工作目录、持久化情况及 live agent 状态和排队消息数。
读取会话记录：调用 read_session 按时间读取指定会话的用户与助手文本消息，可用 limit 限制返回条数。
诊断会话状态：session_status 返回 agent 是否在线、运行状态、排队数及最后事件，供判断是否需要恢复。
恢复卡住的会话：session_recover 对 running 状态 agent 发送取消信号，并设置 keepInbox 保留排队消息。
发送跨会话消息：send_session_message 将文本投递给在线 agent，或先恢复持久化会话再投递。

dsh-session-doctor README · dsh-session-doctor · 会话医生：[English](./README.en.md) | 中文

> 诊断、解卡、读取 DeepSeek Harness 会话的插件。给每个会话装上五个工具,让你能查看、诊断、恢复、指挥其他 Agent 会话。
dsh-session-doctor README · 这是什么：典型场景:发现另一个会话卡住不动 → 诊断确认 → 解卡恢复 → 查看它后续的进展 → 必要时发消息指挥它继续。

dsh-session-doctor README · 功能：| 能力 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| `list_sessions` | 列出所有会话:id、标题、工作目录、持久化状态、**agent 运行状态**、排队消息数 |
| `read_session` | 读取指定会话的对话记录(用户/助手文本消息),按序返回,支持 `limit` |
| `session_status` | 诊断目标会话:是否在线、`running`/`idle`、inbox 排队数、最后事件 |
| `session_recover` | **解卡**:对卡死的 `running` agent 发取消信号(`keepInbox: true`),中止卡住的活动、保留排队消息 |
| `send_session_message` | 向目标会话发消息:在线直接投递;仅持久化自动恢复后投递 |

dsh-session-doctor README · 方式一:一行命令：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-session-doctor
```

dsh-session-doctor README · 方式二:从 GitHub 安装：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:mayf3/dsh-session-doctor
```

text: dsh-session-doctor README · 与 dsh-agent-message 的关系：[dsh-agent-message](https://github.com/GengDaPeng/dsh-agent-message) 专注**跨会话消息收发**(五种投递模式、回执、会话导航);本插件专注**会话健康**(诊断、解卡、读取记录),并提供一个简单的消息投递入口。两者可以共存:消息收发用 agent-message,卡住了解卡用 session-doctor。

dsh-session-doctor README · 目录结构：```
dsh-session-doctor/
├── lib/
│   └── index.js      # host 半区:五个工具

dsh-session-doctor README · 限制：- `session_recover` 只作用于 live agent(`running` 状态);离线会话不存在卡住的活动,无需解卡。
- `send_session_message` 的离线恢复以默认模型启动目标会话(不继承它上次手动切换的模型选择)。
- 跨进程/跨机器通信不在本插件范围内。

dsh-session-doctor README · dsh-session-doctor：[English](./README.en.md) | 中文

> Diagnose, unstick, and read DeepSeek Harness sessions. Five tools for every session: list, read, diagnose, recover, and message other Agent sessions.

dsh-session-doctor README · What is this：In DeepSeek Harness, one process hosts many Agent sessions. A session can get stuck — for example, a Client-platform query like `cordis_inspect_query` waits forever for a page response, the agent stays `running`, and later messages pile up in the inbox unprocessed. This plugin provides:
dsh-session-doctor README · What is this：Typical flow: notice another session is stuck → diagnose → recover → read its progress → message it to continue.

dsh-session-doctor README · Features：| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `list_sessions` | List all sessions: id, title, cwd, persisted state, **agent status**, pending counts |
| `read_session` | Read a session's conversation (user/assistant text), time-ordered, with `limit` |
| `session_status` | Diagnose a session: online, `running`/`idle`, inbox pending counts, last event |
| `session_recover` | **Unstick**: cancel a stuck `running` agent with `keepInbox: true` — abort stuck activity, keep queued messages |
| `send_session_message` | Send a message to a session: direct when online; auto-resume persisted sessions |

dsh-session-doctor README · One-liner：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-session-doctor
```

dsh-session-doctor README · From GitHub：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:mayf3/dsh-session-doctor
```

dsh-session-doctor README · Via your Agent：In any DSH session, send:

> 帮我安装会话医生插件,执行:`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-session-doctor`

dsh-session-doctor README · Relationship to dsh-agent-message：[dsh-agent-message](https://github.com/GengDaPeng/dsh-agent-message) focuses on **cross-session messaging** (five delivery modes, receipts, session navigation); this plugin focuses on **session health** (diagnosis, recovery, reading) with a simple send entry. They coexist: use agent-message for messaging, use session-doctor when a session gets stuck.

dsh-session-doctor README · Directory layout：```
dsh-session-doctor/
├── lib/
│   └── index.js      # host half: five tools
├── cordis.patch.yml  # self-register patch (pointed by dsh.bundle.patch)

dsh-session-doctor README · Limitations：- `session_recover` only acts on live agents (`running`); offline sessions have no stuck activity to recover.
- `send_session_message` resumes offline sessions with the default model (not the model manually selected last time).
- Cross-process / cross-machine messaging is out of scope.
